title: Stone Town
description: UNESCO World Heritage site with historic architecture, bustling markets, and cultural tours.

title: Nungwi Beach
description: White‑sand beach on the northern tip of Zanzibar, perfect for sunbathing, snorkeling, and sunset cruises.

title: Jozani Forest
description: Home to the rare Red Colobus monkey and guided eco‑tours through mangrove and forest trails.

title: Prison Island
description: Historical prison turned marine reserve, famous for giant tortoises and snorkeling spots.

title: Spice Farm
description: Explore Zanzibar’s spice heritage with guided tours of clove, cinnamon, and nutmeg plantations.
